activity.title: commented on #347 in BaaRai/ARTEX
activity.detail: Operator-side hardening: approval gate for third-party code, optional egress allowlist, pinned base images

curated.report: the decode fixture was too small to compress on Go 1.27, so `TestDecodeEvidenceBody` failed on any current toolchain
curated.outcome: the fixture now has something worth deflating, and the guard asserts the stored-block size ratio instead of a plaintext substring

curated.report: `ingest_bbot` trusted `scope_distance` from `output.json`, and the allow-list was the only scope gate; a demoted or unscoped item could present as pre-scoped ([#317](https://github.com/BaaRai/ARTEX/issues/317))
curated.outcome: the maintainer chose documentation over a code change: SECURITY.md now states that `scope_distance` is trusted input, that `EvaluateAssetGate` applies block rules whether or not a task allow-list is configured, and that the no-allow-list case is an accepted gap

curated.report: `record_fact` accepted evidence that never appeared in the intent's recorded work, so a line a target planted could be labelled `tool_output` and still satisfy `prove_goal` ([#124](https://github.com/BaaRai/ARTEX/issues/124))
curated.outcome: the server now ties every fact to a recorded activity or a captured exchange, relabels target-returned bytes as `target_response`, and refuses an untied fact at `prove_goal`; the documented limits are capture-off ties to recorded work, not authorship, and the agent's own output also counting as recorded activity

curated.report: the `factProvenance` doc comment sat on the struct's closing brace, so it documented nothing
curated.outcome: the comment now sits on the field it describes

curated.report: `nato()` mapped A-Z only and silently dropped every digit, so the probe scored text the target was never shown; 56 of 163 shipped payloads carry digits
curated.outcome: digits now map to the ICAO alphabet (Niner for 9), 186 pass

curated.report: tool calls cut off by the output cap were still dispatched in the non-chat loops, and the explorer never captured `finish_reason` at all
curated.outcome: one choke-point guard plus the missing capture, 22/22 CI green

curated.report: the truncation guard covers the chat path only: the same cut-off tool calls reach five dispatch sites outside it
curated.outcome: filed with a runtime repro: a scripted truncated round, the real dispatch code, and a real Obsidian vault that gets mutated while history records a fabricated success

curated.report: provider reported `stopped` while the QEMU process was alive, once the tmp-dir pidfile vanished
curated.outcome: the fix shipped in 0.8.0: runtime state moved into a project-local run dir, migrated and verified on both of my VMs; what removed the old directory is still unidentified

curated.report: LXC `mount (rw, move)` denied by AppArmor blocks container start on kernel 7.x
